propositions: The substring-based CI ChatOps matcher (lfit/releng-gerrit_to_platform) maps 'recheck' to verify, and comments containing the retired LLM trigger word 'recheck-review' spuriously dispatch the Verified workflow, cancelling in-flight CI runs and leaving Verified -1 states that reflect cancellation not failure.
The bot's own reply texts (_ACCEPTED_MESSAGE and _refusal_message) embed the retired trigger word verbatim, so every bot-posted comment itself re-dispatches the CI workflow.
The new trigger token 'rerun-llm-review' contains no substring matching any ini-mapped comment-added key and no ini key contains it, eliminating the collision with the immutable external CI matcher.
A comment carrying the retired word must never enqueue a review event, never reset a vote, and must post exactly one refusal reply that names the new trigger without re-spelling the retired word.
All bot-posted text must be scrubbed of every ini-mapped trigger word to prevent self-dispatch; retired-word refusal describes the old trigger descriptively rather than spelling it.
A hard cutover with no deprecation window prevents the old word from remaining a live source of CI dispatch collisions.
